attributes.name: Skyrocket Crossbow
attributes.powers:
For your combat check, reveal this card to roll your Dexterity or Ranged skill + 1d8+ 2; you may additionally discard this card to add another 1d8. 

If you are proficient with weapons, you may recharge this card to add 1d8+2 to any combat check at another location, or you may recharge this card and choose a character to succeed at a check to defeat a summoned bane.
